name: Tom Reid
role: Hid in the toilets for a dare
bio: Seventeen. His mates bet him he couldn't stay in the mall overnight. They went home.

name: Marcus Hale
bio: Twelve years on nights. He has never once heard the building make that sound before.

name: Priya Sharma
bio: Stayed late to finish a stock count. The shutters came down with her still inside.

name: Ruth Okafor
bio: Has cleaned these floors for twenty years. Knows every corridor, every cupboard, every vent.

name: Dan Kowalski
bio: Called in to fix the lifts. Knows the breakers better than anyone, and that is about to matter.

name: Leah Brennan
bio: Climbed in through the car park to film the empty mall. Her camera battery died an hour ago.

name: Kenji Mori
bio: Last drop of the night was to the loading bay. The bay door shut behind him.

name: Sofia Marín
bio: Locking up the café at the far end of the food court when the lights went out.

name: Arthur Pike
bio: Worked here when it opened in 1989. Came back for one last look before it's demolished.

name: Jade Thompson
bio: Fell asleep in the cinema during the late showing. Woke up to the exit doors chained.
